title: Galuska
instructions: Beat one egg, add one-quarter cup water, one-eighth teaspoon salt, and flour to make a stiff drop batter. Drop from a spoon into boiling water and cook about ten minutes.

Chop one-half pound liver and add one egg yolk. Season with pepper and salt, adding enough flour or farina to hold the mixture together. Mix thoroughly. Drop from one spoon into gently boiling clear soup or salted water and cook about ten minutes. Serve two or three balls in each plate of soup. The balls should be small and of uniform size.
